# Job commands never create, start or replace a VM, and refuse a task
# the VM cannot run before any EC2 call or session.

# No VM was ever created: refused without a mutation or a job directory.
! job run -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
mutations 0
opens 0
! exists $WORK/j

skygo-ec2 start -config $CONFIG -state $STATE -credentials $CREDS -interval 0
code 0
mutations 1

# Usage errors.
! job run -job $WORK/j -workdir $WORK/src
code 2
! job run -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/task.json -yaml $WORK/task.yaml -workdir $WORK/src
code 2
! job run -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/task.json
code 2
! job run -job $WORK/j -yaml $WORK/task.yaml -workdir $WORK/src
code 2
! job run -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src -outputs out
code 2
! job run -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src -timeout 25h
code 2

# Tasks the VM cannot run: refused before any EC2 call.
ec2mark
! job run -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/gpu.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
stderr 'accelerators are not supported'
! job run -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/long.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
stderr 'task timeout exceeds the configured maximum'
! job run -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/forever.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
stderr 'task timeout must be finite'
! job run -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/workdir.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
stderr 'must not name a workdir'
! job run -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/other-target.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
stderr 'target is not the configured agent target'
! job run -job $WORK/j -yaml $WORK/nodes.yaml -workdir $WORK/src -task-timeout 60s
code 1
! job run -job $WORK/j -yaml $WORK/cloud.yaml -workdir $WORK/src -task-timeout 60s
code 1
stderr 'resources.cloud'
! job run -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/missing
code 1
! job run -job-config $JOBCONFIG_OPEN -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
ec2since 0
opens 0
! exists $WORK/j

# Another instance than the lifecycle state holds: refused before any
# EC2 call.
! job run -job-config $JOBCONFIG_OTHER -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
ec2since 0

# A public address the VM does not have: refused after describing it.
! job run -job-config $JOBCONFIG_PUBLIC -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
opens 0
! exists $WORK/j

# A VM stopped outside skygo is never started for a job.
ec2state stopped
! job run -job $WORK/j -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
opens 0
! exists $WORK/j

# A job directory that does not exist is never created by other commands.
! job job-status -job $WORK/none
code 1
! job cancel -job $WORK/none
code 1
! exists $WORK/none

mutations 1
jobs 0

{"argv":["/bin/true"],"workdir":{"id":"00000000000000000000000000000000","sha256":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","size":"1"},"timeoutSeconds":"60"}

{"argv":["/bin/true"],"target":"dgx","timeoutSeconds":"60"}
-- task.yaml --
workdir: .
run: "true"

num_nodes: 2

resources:
